verdict.rationale: Loops documents transactional email as its own send type, with a dedicated POST /transactional endpoint and data variables, for receipts and password resets, sent alongside marketing campaigns. Nothing in the evidence shows unsubscribed contacts still receive transactional mail, separate suppression handling, or a separate sending reputation, and the 'one contact model' framing points to shared infrastructure. Missing for 10: documented delivery of transactional email to unsubscribed contacts, separate suppression rules, separate IP/domain reputation, explicit separate transactional template management, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, transactional email is kept separate from marketing — its own templates, suppression rules, and reputation — so a receipt still delivers to an unsubscribed contact
